question: Who among the following was defeated in the Battle of Kannauj in 1540?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Humayun.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Battle of Kannauj** was fought between the **Mughal Emperor Humayun** and the **Afghan ruler Sher Shah Suri** in **1540.**
 
• Sher Shah Suri emerged **victorious in the battle** and** Humayun** was forced to** flee to Iran**.
 
• The battle is considered as a turning point in the history of India as it marked the** end of the Mughal rule **and the beginning of the **Sur dynasty.**
 
• Sher Shah Suri went on to establish a** strong administration** and introduced various reforms, such as the introduction of the **rupee as a currency** and the construction of the **Grand Trunk Road.**
 
• **Akbar,** who was the son of **Humayun,** later **defeated the Sur dynasty **and established the **Mughal rule **in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hemu,** also known as Hemchandra Vikramaditya, was a** Hindu king** who ruled over **Delhi **in the **16th century.**
 
• **Sher Shah Suri** was a **Pashtun warrior **who rose to power after defeating the **Mughal Emperor Humayun.**
 
 
• He is known for his **administrative and military reforms **and is considered as one of the greatest rulers of **medieval India. **
 
 
 
• **Akbar** was the **third Mughal Emperor **who ruled over India from **1556 to 1605.**
 
 
• He is known for his** religious tolerance, military conquests, and cultural achievements.**
 
 
 
• **Humayun **was the **second Mughal Emperor** who ruled over India from **1530 to 1540 **and from** 1555 to 1556.**
 
 
• He was known for his** military failures** and was forced to flee to Iran after his defeat in the Battle of Kannauj.
